title: Child in Hooded Coat on Brick Steps, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot showing a young child viewed from behind, wearing a warm hooded winter coat and trousers. The toddler stands near the brick steps leading up to the entrance of a stone residential home, flanked by neatly manicured rounded shrubs. The photograph features deckled edges characteristic of mid-20th century family snapshots. Blue ink handwriting on the front bottom margin reads '3 1/2', denoting the child's age when the picture was taken.
